description_en: A bench with solid curved wooden end cheeks clad in woven cane, a high woven back and continuous seat; the front shows enclosed seat ends, the side reveals one sculpted end cheek, and the rear shows a high framed back and a small plain rear ledge. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A bench with solid curved wooden end cheeks clad in woven cane, a high woven back and continuous seat; the front shows enclosed seat ends, the side reveals one sculpted end cheek, and the rear shows a high framed back and a small plain rear ledge. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
